$comment: Tenant configuration — one file per country / white-label buyer. Selected at build time via NEXT_PUBLIC_TENANT (default: 'default'). Every value here replaces a former hardcoding so new markets launch without code changes. Buyer stacks are fully isolated (own DB + ES + deploy), so no tenant_id plumbing is needed.

filterNormalization.$comment: Cache-key normalization: snap continuous inputs to buckets so near-identical searches share one ES query. Price snaps WIDEN (min floors, max ceils) so results stay a superset — applied to BOTH the ES query and the hash, never hash-only. Steps are per display currency; scope=both uses the finest involved step.
